context.heading: Context
context.body: BoostDuka is a Business Intelligence tool designed and built end to end by Benjamin, based on a fictional case study — VISIBA Logistics Group, 6 operational bases in the Democratic Republic of Congo — to demonstrate, on a concrete case, command of the intersection between procurement, supply chain and data/BI that defines the Procurement Manager Intersection role in a multi-site humanitarian organization.

problem.heading: The problem it solves
problem.intro: Without a cross-cutting tool, a multi-site organization repeats the same pitfalls:
problem.item1: Prices that can't be compared across sections, for lack of a shared price base.
problem.item2: Untraceable supplier selection — no audit trail on why a given supplier was chosen over another.
problem.item3: Underused framework agreements, for lack of visibility into their utilization rate and deadlines.
problem.item4: Scattered procurement KPIs (lead times, on-time delivery rate, budget exposure), with no consolidated dashboard.

solution.heading: The solution — 10 modules, one data model
solution.intro: Every module relies on the same relational model, designed from the start for downstream BI use: an imported quote instantly feeds the comparative bid sheet, the CBA, the purchase order, and then the dashboard.

skills.heading: Skills demonstrated
skills.item1: Procurement analysis — a transparent, documented weighted multi-criteria scoring methodology, rather than arbitrary judgment.
skills.item2: Data modeling — a normalized relational schema, designed for downstream BI use (star schema, N-N bridge tables).
skills.item3: Multi-site advisory — a dashboard structured around the real decision points of an intersection analyst.
skills.item4: Methodological rigor — KPIs without a dedicated data source are replaced by an explicitly labeled proxy, rather than fabricated.
skills.item5: BI / reporting — a complete Power BI export (relational model + DAX measures), an interactive dashboard with cross-filters.

importance.heading: Why this tool matters
importance.body: A Procurement Manager Intersection doesn't just negotiate prices: at every donor review and every audit, they must prove that the chosen supplier was selected for good, documented, reproducible, defensible reasons. BoostDuka operationalizes exactly that discipline: every award produces an archivable CBA, every framework agreement shows its real utilization rate, every imported quote feeds a consolidated dashboard instead of a spreadsheet siloed per section. It's the same discipline applied in the <link>Internal Audit & Controls</link> pillar of this site — applied here to the tool itself, not only to the assignment.
